mechanism_narrative: ERBB2-FGFR4 forced proximity via flexible_GS4 linker (~20 A) enables transphosphorylation between the two RTK kinase domains, recruiting GRB2-SHC1-FRS2-GAB1-PIK3R1-PTPN11 adaptors to drive MAPK/ERK and PI3K/AKT signaling while sterically excluding PLCgamma docking. The biased output upregulates muscle structural genes (ACTA2, MYL9, MYH11, MYOM2, TAGLN, MYL6, TPM2, NOTCH3) and downregulates aged-marker IEGs (EGR1, FOS, JUN, OTUD1, TXNIP, IL32, MYF5, MYH9), mirroring the rejuvenating signature of prior ERBB2+FGFR1/2/4 wins.
